item.tib: lha rgyal bkra shis glu dbyangs
item.coloph: de skad lha rgyal bkra shis glu dbyangs 'di/ gsang sngags bzlog (zlog) phrin spyi la nyer mkho'i ched/ sgo rigs mkhan ming nyi ri shel bzhin gyis/ bkra shis sman ri'i gnas su brtsams pa dge gyur cig/
